|---|---------|---------|---------|------------|
| 0.1 random | 0% (0/79) | **38.3%** (36/94) | **pending** | — |
| 0.3 random | 8.3% (4/48) | 7.6% (7/92) | 0% (0/23) | 6.7% (11/163) |
